text.p: Northeast Utilities said Thursday it has signed letters of intent with PECO Nuclear and Virginia Power to provide continued management support for Millstone Units 1 and 2 respectively.
Northeast's three Millstone nuclear plants have been closed for safety reasons since March of last year. The utility has said it plans to have all three plants ready for restart by early 1998.

In the agreement, Northeast Nuclear will enter into two-year contracts with the utilities, effective March 1 of this year through February 28, 1999, or until one year after restart -- whichever is later, Northeast said.
PECO Nuclear and Virginia Power will continue to support Northeast Nuclear with core management and employee teams.
Virginia Power is a subsidiary of Dominion Resources. PECO Nuclear is a unit of PECO Energy Co
These teams have been helping with the Millstone recovery plans since October of last year.
